name: Cando Drones Ltd.
summary: Cando Drones Ltd. is an aviation company, which engages in the establishment and management of autonomous drone systems. The firm also offers turn-key solutions that includes the organization of the aerial space, regulation, characterization, choosing and integrating systems, ground logistics management, implementation, training, professional, and technical guidance. Its products and solutions include security, mapping, surveying, inspections, public safety, enforcement, delivery, and boxair. The company was founded by Yoely Or, Alon Kloss, Moshe Kipnis, and Alon Zeboski in 2019 and is headquartered in Ganot Hadar, Israel.
